name: Rindou Misogi
source: A transfer student from a traditional family who came from the countryside to Seitengi Academy. She also lives alone and performs her miko training alongside with her studies. Misogi has a habit of explaining things in such a great detail that people often get confused or misunderstand what she's trying to say.
